artifact: Issue #9 M4-2 current authorization and capability audit

entries.current_capability: Evaluates trusted principal, exact operation, typed target, scope, Subject revision, lease, approval, and Decision evidence without selecting semantic intent or writing the graph.
entries.current_limit: No durable authorization materialization or lease issuance boundary exists; supplied facts must already be valid.

entries.current_capability: Carries principal/context, operation, target, scope, lease, Subject revision, contract hash, approval, and Decision evidence into evaluation.
entries.current_limit: Does not carry the complete M4-2 intent, candidate, external precondition, reservation, or authorization evidence binding required for issuance.

entries.current_capability: Immutable bounded value object with principal, operation, typed target, scope, issued/expiry times, expected Subject revision, optional contract hash, approval/Decision basis, and fixture state copies.
entries.current_limit: It is not durable semantic authority; it has no M4-2 issuer protocol, exact intent/candidate binding, durable revocation, or atomic consumption.

entries.current_capability: Validates bounded identifiers, timestamps, TTL, scope, principal type, target type, revision, and contract hash; AuthorityEngine checks principal/operation/target/scope/time/revision matches.
entries.current_limit: Validation does not yet prove exact MutationIntent, authorization reservation, candidate identity, or external authority precondition binding.

entries.current_capability: No issuer or issuance function is implemented.
entries.current_limit: There is no boundary that converts existing semantic authorization into an exact bounded short-lived lease.

entries.current_capability: Expiry is deterministic at now >= expires_at and TTL is bounded by MAX_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS.
entries.current_limit: Expiry validation is local value validation; no durable issuer or lifecycle store consumes the result.

entries.current_capability: Transaction-local fixture foundation can stage one lease ID for atomic test-store consumption and rejects known consumed IDs.
entries.current_limit: CapabilityLease consume_for_fixture returns a copy; no production or durable lease-consumption service exists.

entries.current_capability: Fixture revoke returns an isolated revoked copy and AuthorityEngine rejects revoked state.
entries.current_limit: Revocation is not persisted, coordinated with issuance, or an atomic runtime operation.

entries.current_capability: Authority and basis references can be supplied as trusted facts and checked by the existing evaluator.
entries.current_limit: No durable M4-2 semantic authorization record or issuance correlation/reservation binding exists.

entries.current_capability: ApprovalEvidence is a distinct typed value with approver trust, operation, target, revision, scope, and digest validation.
entries.current_limit: It does not itself establish a MaterializedDecisionEvidence record and cannot fill a missing Decision basis.

entries.current_capability: Binds a durable Decision ObjectRef and resolved Decision canonical fields to operation, target, revision, scope, and a digest.
entries.current_limit: The evaluator only validates an already-materialized Decision; it cannot create or infer one.

entries.current_capability: Describes semantic operation, logical target, mutation scope, semantic inputs, idempotency key, and deterministic intent fingerprint while excluding trusted fields.
entries.current_limit: Intent is not authority, does not select a typed target, and does not grant a lease.

entries.current_capability: Deterministic SHA-256 semantic identity excludes correlation and trusted/mechanical preconditions.
entries.current_limit: No issuer currently binds this fingerprint to an authorization reservation or lease.

entries.current_capability: Authority evaluation and isolated transaction mechanics reject a lease whose expected revision differs from the current Subject revision.
entries.current_limit: The source primitive is isolated and does not establish the external authority revision domain.

entries.current_capability: M4-0 and M4-1 name raw source revision/digest and candidate raw digest as separate mechanical values.
entries.current_limit: No external authority read, CAS, adapter, or lease binding implementation exists.

entries.current_capability: Descriptor contract_hash is deterministic and AuthorityEngine rejects a mismatched request/lease contract hash.
entries.current_limit: No M4-2 issuer records contract drift against a complete authorization reservation.

entries.current_capability: Only a runtime-bound TrustedContext can promote a Principal to trusted status; ordinary model values and plain Principal values are ignored as authority assertions.
entries.current_limit: Trusted context is evidence, not semantic authorization and not a self-asserted lease.

entries.current_capability: Assembles operation context and trusted adapter metadata without choosing Subjects/projects or minting authority.
entries.current_limit: It cannot resolve M4-2 semantic authorization or issue a lease.

entries.current_capability: Isolated store supports same-key/same-fingerprint replay and same-key/different-fingerprint conflict.
entries.current_limit: It is not a durable authorization reservation and does not itself issue or consume a lease.

entries.current_capability: The isolated transaction foundation stages lease consumption with graph/revision/idempotency changes atomically in its test store.
entries.current_limit: This is not a durable production lease lifecycle and is outside this planning-only work item.

entries.current_capability: M4-0 freezes reconcile-before-retry and M4-1 represents OUTCOME_UNKNOWN without verified success.
entries.current_limit: No external journal, readback reconciliation, or recovery issuer path exists in the current source.
